TradingView Lightweight Charts 5.2.0

This distribution includes the standalone production build of TradingView
Lightweight Charts. It is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see
LIGHTWEIGHT_CHARTS_LICENSE.txt in this directory.

The application serves this fixed asset locally, enables the official
TradingView attribution logo, and does not load the chart library from a CDN.
Source and integrity details are recorded in THIRD_PARTY.md.
